title: Rukh
description: Under the employ of Grand Admiral Thrawn, Rukh was his faithful Noghri assassin. An agile and lethal hand-to-hand fighter, Rukh took on missions for the Grand Admiral that his Imperial subordinates were unwilling to or incapable of completing. Rukh hunted down the crew of the Ghost for Thrawn and was on hand to aid Thrawn in the final confrontation against them on Lothal. Unfortunately, Garazeb Orrelios saw to it that Rukh met a shocking end.
